findings.title: Read authorisation missing: every signed-in account receives the whole database
findings.evidence: GET /api/session as a driver -> 795770 bytes; users 2, vehicles 41, clients 2, routes 30, trips 1500, audit 2012
findings.fix: Apply scopedView() server-side in both snapshot responses, with a per-role test.

findings.title: Sign-in throttle bypassed with a forged X-Forwarded-For
findings.evidence: 8 attempts -> 401 x8, 429 on 9th; 9 attempts rotating XFF -> 401 x9
findings.fix: Bucket on email as well as address; trust XFF only with TRUST_PROXY=1.

findings.title: Command payloads are not validated; malformed input returns 500
findings.evidence: TypeError: input.seatCapacity.trim is not a function (service.ts:269); reproduced for create_vehicle, create_user, update_settings, record_odometer
findings.fix: Zod schema per command type before the transaction opens.

findings.title: Production 500s are never logged
findings.evidence: commands.ts:203 logs only when NODE_ENV !== production; 'The server log has the detail' points at an empty log
findings.fix: Log command type + error class/message at error level in every environment.

findings.title: Full-snapshot API: 792 kB per request at 1500 trips, unbounded
findings.evidence: GET /api/session 791877 bytes / 35-47 ms; every command returns the same snapshot; AUDIT_LIMIT 5000 caps only audit
findings.fix: Scoped payload (F-01), then return the changed record instead of the snapshot; page collections.

findings.title: No CI run has ever executed
findings.evidence: gh api repos/iwani1/Richie-RTS-/actions/runs -> total_count 0; ci.yml triggers on push to main and on PRs only
findings.fix: Trigger on all branches or open the PR; fix what the first run reports.

findings.title: Scaffold screen 'Project brief' ships in the nav for every role
findings.evidence: routes.ts:46 permission null; BriefDesk.tsx 512 lines, 8% covered, old class names absent from index.css, writes localStorage
findings.fix: Delete the route, nav item and component.

findings.title: No Origin check on state-changing requests
findings.evidence: POST /api/commands with Origin: https://evil.example processed (refused for a business reason, not a security one)
findings.fix: Reject mismatched Origin when the header is present.

findings.title: Password reset does not revoke existing sessions
findings.evidence: cookie TTL 8h; reset updates hash only; Users.tsx:238 notice still says 'browser-local build'
findings.fix: Per-user session epoch checked per request.

findings.title: HSTS absent though the config comment promises it
findings.evidence: response headers on / contain no Strict-Transport-Security
findings.fix: Add when TLS is terminated; gate on an explicit env flag.

findings.title: CSP allows unsafe-inline scripts and two unused Google font origins
findings.evidence: script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src ... https://fonts.googleapis.com; fonts are self-hosted via @fontsource
findings.fix: Drop the Google origins now; add a nonce later.

findings.title: Secure cookie makes plain-HTTP LAN access unusable
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie includes Secure in production; localhost is exempt in browsers, a LAN IP is not
findings.fix: Document TLS-in-front or a deliberate development posture.

findings.title: Panel dialogs lack focus trap, Escape and focus restore
findings.evidence: Panel sets role=dialog/aria-modal only; scrim is a button labelled 'Close panel' duplicating the header close
findings.fix: Focus first control, trap Tab, close on Escape, restore focus.

findings.title: Docs and code comments describe things that no longer exist
findings.evidence: README: Docker/Podman Compose (deleted), 169 tests (177), 'Zod at every request boundary' (false); PROGRESS.md:19 compose; rateLimit.ts cites missing docs/SECURITY-NOTES.md; scope.ts says 'this build has no server'

findings.title: Coverage uneven; route handlers untested
findings.evidence: Users.tsx 0%, Registers.tsx 4.08%, BriefDesk.tsx 8.13%, Settings.tsx 65.51%; no tests under src/app/api
findings.fix: Start with the per-role snapshot test required by F-01.

findings.title: Application role owns the schema and can disable the append-only trigger
findings.evidence: migrations run as the connecting role; audit_append_only_trg is disableable by the table owner
findings.fix: Split owner and app roles if the deployment grows.

findings.title: /api/health discloses PostgreSQL version and extensions unauthenticated
findings.fix: Return the detail only outside production.
